DCLTRHST
DECLARE CARDDEMO.TRAN_HIST TABLE
( TH_TRAN_ID                     CHAR(16) NOT NULL,
TH_ACCT_ID                     DECIMAL(11, 0) NOT NULL,
TH_CARD_NUM                    CHAR(16) NOT NULL,
TH_TYPE_CD                     CHAR(2) NOT NULL,
TH_CAT_CD                      CHAR(4) NOT NULL,
TH_SOURCE                      CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
TH_DESC                        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
TH_AMT                         DECIMAL(11, 2) NOT NULL,
TH_MERCHANT_ID                 DECIMAL(9, 0),
TH_MERCHANT_NAME               VARCHAR(50),
TH_MERCHANT_CITY               VARCHAR(50),
TH_MERCHANT_ZIP                CHAR(10),
TH_TRAN_DATE                   DATE NOT NULL,
TH_ORIG_TS                     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
TH_PROC_TS                     TIMESTAMP
)
DCLACDBL
DECLARE CARDDEMO.ACCT_DAILY_BAL TABLE
( ADB_ACCT_ID                    DECIMAL(11, 0) NOT NULL,
ADB_BAL_DATE                   DATE NOT NULL,
ADB_OPEN_BAL                   DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
ADB_CREDIT_AMT                 DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
ADB_DEBIT_AMT                  DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
ADB_CLOSE_BAL                  DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
ADB_TRAN_CNT                   INTEGER NOT NULL,
ADB_CREDIT_LIMIT               DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
ADB_OVERLIMIT_FLG              CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
ADB_FLAG_DATE                  DATE
)
DECLARE C-REPORT CURSOR FOR
SELECT H.TH_ACCT_ID
, H.TH_TYPE_CD
, H.TH_CAT_CD
, H.TH_TRAN_ID
, H.TH_TRAN_DATE
, H.TH_AMT
, COALESCE(H.TH_MERCHANT_NAME, '-')
, B.ADB_CLOSE_BAL
, B.ADB_CREDIT_LIMIT
FROM CARDDEMO.TRAN_HIST H
LEFT OUTER JOIN CARDDEMO.ACCT_DAILY_BAL B
ON B.ADB_ACCT_ID  = H.TH_ACCT_ID
AND B.ADB_BAL_DATE = :WS-END-DATE
WHERE H.TH_TRAN_DATE BETWEEN :WS-START-DATE
AND :WS-END-DATE
ORDER BY H.TH_ACCT_ID
, H.TH_TYPE_CD
, H.TH_CAT_CD
, H.TH_TRAN_ID
FOR READ ONLY
SELECT CHAR(DATE(:WS-PARM-START-DATE), ISO)
, CHAR(DATE(:WS-PARM-END-DATE), ISO)
INTO :WS-START-DATE
, :WS-END-DATE
FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
OPEN C-REPORT
FETCH C-REPORT
INTO :DCL-TH-ACCT-ID
, :DCL-TH-TYPE-CD
, :DCL-TH-CAT-CD
, :DCL-TH-TRAN-ID
, :DCL-TH-TRAN-DATE
, :DCL-TH-AMT
, :WS-MERCHANT
, :DCL-ADB-CLOSE-BAL    :WS-IND-CLOSE-BAL
, :DCL-ADB-CREDIT-LIMIT :WS-IND-CREDIT-LIMIT
CLOSE C-REPORT
ROLLBACK
